title: geum hispidum var. albarracinense
intro: Geum hispidum var. albarracinense, commonly known as White Spanish Avens, is a plant species within the Rosaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to support digestive health and reduce inflammation. The plant is thought to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its potential health benefits. Bioactive constituents of White Spanish Avens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects.
